articles.title_en: After displacement: Coal mining, development, and inequality in the Thar desert of Pakistan
articles.title_cn: 流离失所之后：巴基斯坦塔尔沙漠的煤炭开采、发展与不平等
articles.abstract_en: This paper will examine the resettlement process initiated under the Thar Coal Project, located in the arid Thar desert region in southern Pakistan, which is likely to cause the displacement of at least ten villages, many of whom are inhabited by marginalized Hindu Dalit and pastoralist tribal populations. We will focus on those displaced villagers who have been resettled in New Sehnri Dars village and those who have lost land in Bhawa Jo Tar village, taking an ethnographic approach. Large scale development induced displacement and resettlement (DiDR) has occurred in Pakistan, but it has been subject to limited scholarship. Individuals being displaced by large scale infrastructure projects, referred by some as ‘development refugees,’ face material losses leading to impoverishment. The paper here focuses on the recovery and reconstruction of the displaced population and how they have been rebuilding their livelihoods and communities after getting forcibly relocated, beginning from 2017 onwards. We argue that some aspects of DiDR may contribute to positive outcomes resulting in accumulation of sociocultural and educational capital for the traditionally marginalized groups. The displacement literature from the Global South, focuses on forms of coercive control, administered by institutional structures that generated and normalised state led bureaucratic violence, leading to the disempowering of those displaced by infrastructural development. The voices from Senhri Dars and Bhawa Jo Tar in Pakistan give us a different picture of the relationship between infrastructural development and displacement, showing how—quite counter-intuitively—a situation defined by force and coercion can become in a limited way a process that enables agency and empowerment. This paper will provide fresh insight into DiDR in the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, a region that has had very limited scholarship on this issue.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了位于巴基斯坦南部干旱的塔尔沙漠地区的塔尔煤炭项目所启动的重新安置过程，该项目可能导致至少十个村庄的居民流离失所，其中许多居民是边缘化的印度教达利特人和游牧部落人口。我们将采用民族志方法，重点关注那些已被重新安置到新塞赫里达尔斯村的流离失所村民，以及那些在巴瓦乔塔尔村失去土地的村民。大规模发展引发的流离失所与重新安置（DiDR）在巴基斯坦已经发生，但相关学术研究有限。因大型基础设施项目而流离失所的个人，被一些人称为“发展难民”，面临物质损失，导致贫困。本文关注流离失所人口的恢复与重建，以及他们在自2017年起被迫搬迁后如何重建生计和社区。我们认为，DiDR的某些方面可能有助于产生积极成果，为传统边缘化群体积累社会文化和教育资本。来自全球南方的流离失所文献侧重于强制性控制形式，这些控制由制度结构实施，这些结构产生并正常化了国家主导的官僚暴力，导致基础设施发展流离失所者被剥夺权力。来自巴基斯坦塞赫里达尔斯和巴瓦乔塔尔的声音为我们提供了基础设施发展与流离失所之间关系的不同图景，展示了——相当反直觉地——一种由武力和强制定义的情境如何在有限程度上成为一个能够实现能动性和赋权的过程。本文将提供对巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国DiDR的新见解，该地区关于此问题的学术研究非常有限。

articles.title_en: Family business during the COVID-19 pandemic in Asia: Role of government financial aid and coping strategies
articles.title_cn: 亚洲新冠肺炎19大流行期间的家族企业：政府财政援助的作用和应对策略
articles.abstract_en: The COVID-19 pandemic has heavily affected economic activities. In emerging Asia, where small family businesses play central roles in their economies, previous studies found that the sector was particularly hard hit by the pandemic. However, little is known about how households have mitigated the negative shocks on their family business during the pandemic. Using datasets from representative household surveys in seventeen Asian countries from the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and the Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) regions, this study investigates the role of business coping strategies and government financial aid in mitigating the adverse impacts of the pandemic on family business conditions in the short run. We find that (i) adoption of coping strategy is associated with a lower probability of both a decline in family business income and family business closure; and (ii) government financial aid is associated with a lower probability of a decline in family business income and a higher probability of adopting coping strategies. This study is one of the first to provide empirical evidence on mitigation mechanisms of family business in emerging Asia. This is important to understand what policies will enable the family business sector to perform better during the future pandemics and other economic crises.
articles.abstract_cn: 新冠肺炎19大流行严重影响了经济活动。在亚洲新兴市场，小型家族企业在其经济中发挥着核心作用，此前的研究发现，该行业受到疫情的打击尤其严重。然而，人们对家庭如何减轻疫情期间家族企业的负面冲击知之甚少。本研究利用东南亚国家联盟 (ASEAN) 和中亚区域经济合作组织 (CAREC) 地区 十七 个亚洲国家的代表性家庭调查数据集，调查了企业应对策略和政府财政援助在短期内减轻疫情对家族企业状况不利影响方面的作用。我们发现（i）采取应对策略与家族企业收入下降和家族企业倒闭的可能性较低有关； (ii) 政府财政援助与家族企业收入下降的可能性较低以及采取应对策略的可能性较高有关。这项研究是第一个为新兴亚洲家族企业缓解机制提供实证证据的研究之一。这对于了解哪些政策将使家族企业部门在未来的流行病和其他经济危机中表现更好非常重要。

articles.title_en: Higher economic growth in poor countries, lower migration flows to the OECD – Revisiting the migration hump with panel data
articles.title_cn: 贫穷国家的经济增长加快，经合组织的移民流量减少——用面板数据重新审视移民高峰
articles.abstract_en: Comparing emigration rates of countries at different stages of economic development, an inverse u-shape emerges. Since the “migration hump” peaks at an average income of 6000 to 10 000 USD, economic progress in developing countries is often assumed to increase migration consistently. However, it is poorly understood to what extend country-level characteristics, individual incomes and other dimensions of development evoke this pattern, which limits its value for causal inference and concrete policy advice. In this paper we focus on the role of economic growth and investigate whether in developing countries emigration indeed increases with economic progress at shorter more policy-relevant time periods of up to 10 years. Using 35 years of data on migration flows to OECD destinations, we successfully reproduce the hump-shape in the cross-section. However, our more rigorous fixed effects panel estimations that exploit the variation over time robustly feature contrasting results: emigration rates fall as incomes increase. This finding holds independent of the level of income a country starts out at. In contrast to prevailing development emigration narratives, our results imply that rising individual incomes discourage emigration and hence conducive economic policies can reduce emigration. Our findings do not rule out that other slow-moving development dimensions such as educational advancement, demographic change, and structural economic transformation could still increase migration in the long term.
articles.abstract_cn: 比较不同经济发展阶段国家的移民率，会出现倒U形。由于“移民驼峰”在平均收入 6000 至 10 000 美元时达到顶峰，因此发展中国家的经济进步通常被认为会持续增加移民。然而，人们对国家层面的特征、个人收入和其他发展维度在多大程度上引发了这种模式知之甚少，这限制了其因果推理和具体政策建议的价值。在本文中，我们重点关注经济增长的作用，并调查在发展中国家，在长达10年的较短、与政策相关的时间段内，移民是否确实随着经济进步而增加。利用35年关于流向经合组织目的地的移民流量的数据，我们成功地再现了横截面中的驼峰形状。然而，我们利用随时间变化的更严格的固定效应面板估计得出了截然不同的结果：随着收入的增加，移民率下降。这一发现与一个国家的初始收入水平无关。与流行的发展移民叙事相反，我们的研究结果表明，个人收入的增加会抑制移民，因此有利的经济政策可以减少移民。我们的研究结果并不排除其他缓慢发展的方面，如教育进步、人口变化和结构性经济转型，从长远来看仍可能增加移民。

articles.title_en: Protect incomes or protect jobs? The role of social policies in post-pandemic recovery
articles.title_cn: 保护收入还是保护就业？社会政策在后疫情复苏中的作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the effectiveness of income protection and job protection policies for the post-pandemic economic recovery of the second half of 2020 through 2021. The paper is based on a new dataset of the budgets of social protection programs implemented as a part of the pandemic stimulus package in 154 countries. The empirical analysis shows that the effect of the social protection response is heterogeneous. In the short run, higher expenditure on job protection measures is associated with more robust GDP growth, increased employment, and decreased inactivity and poverty rates compared to the expansion of income protection programs. Both policies had a significant economic impact only in countries with weaker pre-pandemic social insurance systems. In countries with broader coverage of the social insurance system, the income and job protection programs appear to have a limited impact on post-pandemic recovery. Because the structural economic changes induced by the pandemic are expected to fully materialize in several years, more research is needed to understand the longer-term effects of job protection and income protection policies on labor markets and economic recovery.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了收入保护和就业保护政策对2020年下半年至2021年疫情后经济复苏的有效性。本文基于一个新的数据集，该数据集涵盖了154个国家作为疫情刺激计划一部分而实施的社会保护项目预算。实证分析表明，社会保护应对措施的效果具有异质性。在短期内，与扩大收入保护计划相比，在就业保护措施上更高的支出与更强劲的GDP增长、就业增加以及失业率和贫困率下降相关。这两种政策仅在疫情前社会保险体系较弱的国家产生了显著的经济影响。在社会保险体系覆盖范围更广的国家，收入和就业保护计划对疫情后复苏的影响似乎有限。由于疫情引发的结构性经济变化预计将在几年内完全显现，需要更多研究来理解就业保护和收入保护政策对劳动力市场和经济复苏的长期影响。

articles.title_en: The Great Lockdown and the Small Business: Impact, Channels and Adaptation to the Covid Pandemic
articles.title_cn: 大封锁与小企业：新冠疫情的影响、渠道与适应
articles.abstract_en: In this paper we estimate the effects of the pandemic on Tunisian small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and examine their adaptation processes during the first lockdown. Three simultaneous shocks are examined employing a Difference-in-Differences (DID) framework applied to the national firm census: the labor input shock, the demand shock and the intermediate input shock. We show that SME performance in the first year of the crisis was heavily affected by a combination of labor input, demand and intermediate input shocks, but only the effects of the demand and intermediate input shocks persisted in the following year. Using our own firm survey, we examine three kinds of adaptation strategies: workplace and process adaptation, and trade credit. We find that firms in non-essential sectors were less able to adapt during the first lockdown, suggesting that firm adaptation seems to be more driven by capability than by necessity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估算了疫情对突尼斯中小企业的影响，并考察了它们在首次封锁期间的适应过程。我们利用全国企业普查数据，采用双重差分法分析了三个同时发生的冲击：劳动力投入冲击、需求冲击和中间投入冲击。我们发现，危机第一年中小企业的绩效受到劳动力投入、需求和中间投入冲击组合的严重影响，但只有需求和中间投入冲击的影响在第二年持续存在。利用我们自己的企业调查，我们考察了三种适应策略：工作场所和流程适应，以及贸易信贷。我们发现，非必需行业的企业在首次封锁期间适应能力较弱，这表明企业适应似乎更多由能力而非必要性驱动。

articles.title_en: The effects of illegal armed groups on municipal expenditures in Colombia
articles.title_cn: 非法武装团体对哥伦比亚市政支出的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study assesses the effects of illegal armed groups on expenditures made by municipal governments in Colombia between 2000 and 2013. Specifically, the study examines how the presence of illegal armed groups seems to affect the level of municipal expenditures, while distinguishing between capital investments and current social spending. Limits on political participation and institutional weaknesses helped to propagate the violence that disrupted Colombia in the 1970s and 1980s. Searching for solutions, Colombia transferred important decision-making responsibilities from the central government to regional and local governments. Paradoxically this decentralization opened an opportunity for illegal armed groups to play meaningful roles in local political and economic life, eventually taking control over local resources in several municipalities. To assess the role of these non-state armed groups in municipal resource allocation, our empirical analysis exploits annual data on municipal expenditures and local armed conflict. Empirical results suggest a differentiated impact on capital investments and social spending. These results are robust to multiple treatment framings and definitions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了2000年至2013年间非法武装团体对哥伦比亚市政政府支出的影响。具体而言，研究考察了非法武装团体的存在如何影响市政支出水平，同时区分资本投资和经常性社会支出。政治参与的限制和制度弱点助长了扰乱哥伦比亚1970年代和1980年代的暴力。为寻求解决方案，哥伦比亚将重要的决策责任从中央政府转移给地区和地方各级政府。矛盾的是，这种权力下放为非法武装团体在地方政治和经济生活中发挥重要作用提供了机会，最终在若干市政当局控制了地方资源。为评估这些非国家武装团体在市政资源配置中的作用，我们的实证分析利用了市政支出和地方武装冲突的年度数据。实证结果表明对资本投资和社会支出存在差异化影响。这些结果在多种处理框架和定义下均保持稳健。

articles.title_en: Civil society, the state and institutionalizing welfare rights in India
articles.title_cn: 公民社会、国家与印度福利权利的制度化
articles.abstract_en: In the past two decades India experienced an unprecedented expansion of the rights-based welfare. This expansion cut across a range of sectors − education, employment, public health, poverty reduction − but was also accompanied by a dramatic expansion and deepening of state institutions and a shift from patronage politics to citizen empowerment. In this paper we show that India was a least likely case for welfare expansion and that contrary to what the traditional welfare state literature suggests, civil society was a key driver of reform, but even more vitally has played a significant role in institutionalizing reforms, especially at the local level. We focus on the case of the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, the world’s largest public works program, to discuss how civil society in India effectively framed welfare issues, mobilized to defend the law, helped institutionalize new governance structures like social audits by working with the state and are ensuring continuous accountability by cultivating what we call “user publics”. We draw on the existing literature, fieldwork on village level welfare reform in different subnational regions of India, direct involvement in civil mobilization around rights based laws for over a decade and an ongoing project in which we are collaborating with some of the key architects of the reforms including an archive of over 3000 primary documents.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去二十年中，印度经历了以权利为基础的福利前所未有的扩张。这一扩张跨越了多个部门——教育、就业、公共卫生、减贫——但也伴随着国家机构的急剧扩张和深化，以及从庇护政治向公民赋权的转变。在本文中，我们表明印度是福利扩张最不可能发生的案例，并且与传统福利国家文献所暗示的相反，公民社会是改革的关键驱动力，但更重要的是，它在制度化改革方面发挥了重要作用，尤其是在地方层面。我们聚焦于世界上最大的公共工程计划——《全国农村就业保障法》的案例，讨论印度公民社会如何有效地构建福利议题，动员起来捍卫法律，通过与国家合作帮助制度化新的治理结构，如社会审计，并通过培养我们所谓的“用户公众”来确保持续的问责制。我们借鉴现有文献、印度不同次国家地区村级福利改革的田野调查、十多年来围绕基于权利的法律进行公民动员的直接参与，以及一个正在进行的项目，在该项目中我们与一些改革的关键设计者合作，包括一个包含超过3000份原始文件的档案。

articles.title_en: Aid and child health: A disaggregated analysis of the effects of aid on impaired growth
articles.title_cn: 援助与儿童健康：援助对生长发育迟缓影响的分类分析
articles.abstract_en: Motivated by a recent setback in the fight against child malnutrition, this study explores whether aid projects help reduce stunting or impaired growth among children close to project sites. Focusing on Malawi, a country with a very high stunting prevalence for which we have access to geo-referenced data on aid projects from a broad range of donors, we geographically match spatial data on 778 aid project sites of 22 different donors with anthropometric and background data on 26,604 children under the age of five. The detailed data allows for a disaggregated analysis comparing local aid impacts by types of aid, donor- and recipient groups. To identify the effect of aid, we rely on spatial and temporal variation in aid project coverage and survey rollout, coupled with variation in the child’s age at aid exposure. The empirical results consistently indicate a positive impact of early-life aid exposure on child growth. The positive treatment effect is seemingly driven primarily by multilateral aid and is stronger in rural areas. On the other hand, we observe little heterogeneity by aid type and across socio-economic recipient groups, signaling that the treatment effect stems from improvements across the board in aid receiving areas rather than by interventions targeting the most vulnerable groups. In terms of mechanisms, the results of the mediation analysis underscore the influence of distal determinants of stunting, such as the improved economic conditions of households, which are likely to impact more proximal determinants downstream.
articles.abstract_cn: 鉴于近期在对抗儿童营养不良方面遭遇的挫折，本研究探讨援助项目是否有助于减少项目地点附近儿童的发育迟缓或生长受损。以马拉维为研究对象，该国发育迟缓率极高，我们能够获取来自广泛捐助者的地理参考援助项目数据。我们将来自22个不同捐助者的778个援助项目地点的空间数据与26,604名五岁以下儿童的人体测量和背景数据进行地理匹配。详细数据允许进行分类分析，比较不同类型援助、捐助者和受援群体的地方援助影响。为识别援助效应，我们依赖援助项目覆盖和调查推出的时空变化，以及儿童在援助暴露时的年龄差异。实证结果一致表明，生命早期援助暴露对儿童生长有积极影响。积极处理效应似乎主要由多边援助驱动，并在农村地区更强。另一方面，我们观察到援助类型和社会经济受援群体之间的异质性很小，这表明处理效应源于援助接受地区整体改善，而非针对最脆弱群体的干预措施。在机制方面，中介分析结果强调了发育迟缓远端决定因素的影响，如家庭经济条件的改善，这些因素可能进一步影响更近端的决定因素。

articles.title_en: Childhood vaccinations and the demand for children: Long-term evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 儿童疫苗接种与子女需求：来自印度的长期证据
articles.abstract_en: Childhood vaccinations can increase population growth in the short term by improving the survival rates of young children. Over the long run, reductions in child mortality rates are associated with lower demand for children and lower fertility rates (known as “demographic transition”). Vaccination programs could potentially aid demographic transition by lowering child mortality and improving future health, schooling, and labor market outcomes of vaccinated mothers, but these long-term demographic benefits remain untested. We address this major gap in the literature by examining the associations of India’s national childhood vaccination program (the Universal Immunization Programme or UIP) with future demand for children. We combine data on the district-wise rollout of UIP during 1985–1990 with fertility preference data of 625,000 adult women from the National Family Health Survey of India 2015–2016. We include women who were born five years before and after the rollout period (1980–1995) and were cohabiting with a partner at the time of the survey. We divide these 20–36-year-old women into two groups: those who were exposed to UIP at birth (treatment group) and those who were born before the program (control group). After controlling for individual- and household-level factors and age and district fixed effects, treatment group women are 2% less likely to have at least one child and want 2% fewer children in their lifetime as compared with the control group. The negative associations with at least one childbirth are larger for more educated and richer women, while the associations with desired number of children is larger for uneducated and poorer women.
articles.abstract_cn: 儿童疫苗接种可通过提高幼儿存活率在短期内增加人口增长。从长期来看，儿童死亡率的降低与子女需求减少和生育率下降（即“人口转变”）相关。疫苗接种计划可能通过降低儿童死亡率并改善接种疫苗母亲未来的健康、教育和劳动力市场结果来促进人口转变，但这些长期人口效益尚未得到验证。我们通过考察印度国家儿童免疫计划（Universal Immunisation Programme，简称UIP）与未来子女需求之间的关联，填补了文献中的这一重大空白。我们将1985-1990年间UIP在各地区的推广数据与2015-2016年印度全国家庭健康调查中625,000名成年女性的生育偏好数据相结合。我们纳入了在推广期前后五年内出生（1980-1995年）且在调查时与伴侣同居的女性。我们将这些20-36岁的女性分为两组：出生时暴露于UIP的组（处理组）和在该计划之前出生的组（对照组）。在控制个人和家庭层面因素以及年龄和地区固定效应后，与对照组相比，处理组女性至少生育一个孩子的可能性低2%，且一生中期望的子女数量少2%。至少生育一个孩子的负向关联在受教育程度较高和较富裕的女性中更大，而期望子女数量的负向关联在未受教育和较贫穷的女性中更大。

articles.title_en: The economic lives of refugees
articles.title_cn: 难民的经济生活
articles.abstract_en: The economic lives of refugees are often viewed as relatively homogeneous, and sources of within-group variation remain largely unexplored. We describe the socio-economic diversity of refugees in one particular region: East Africa. Drawing upon first-hand quantitative and qualitative data collected in Kenya, Uganda, and Ethiopia (n = 8,996), the article systematically compares 12 refugee subpopulations living in seven refugee camps and the three capital cities. In order to identify sources of variation, we examine three main questions: (1) What variation is there in socio-economic outcomes? (2) What strategies and resources do refugees rely upon, and how do these vary? (3) How are opportunities and constraints shaped by differences in institutions and identity? Overall, we show that, although the economic lives of refugees have some distinguishing and common features, they are also heterogeneous by host country, urban/camp context, nationality, and household. We explain why describing and understanding sources of within-group variation matters for research and policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 难民的经济生活通常被视为相对同质，群体内部差异的来源在很大程度上仍未得到探索。我们描述了东非某一特定地区难民的社会经济多样性。基于在肯尼亚、乌干达和埃塞俄比亚收集的第一手定量和定性数据（n = 8,996），本文系统比较了居住在七个难民营和三个首都城市的12个难民亚群体。为了确定差异的来源，我们考察了三个主要问题：（1）社会经济结果存在哪些差异？（2）难民依赖哪些策略和资源，这些策略和资源如何变化？（3）制度和身份差异如何塑造机会和限制？总体而言，我们表明，尽管难民的经济生活具有一些显著和共同的特征，但它们也因东道国、城市/营地环境、国籍和家庭而异。我们解释了描述和理解群体内部差异来源对研究和政策的重要性。

articles.title_en: Developing a segregated homeland: How internal displacement in a remittance-receiving region affects transnational migrants’ development practices
articles.title_cn: 打造隔离的家园：汇款接收地区的内部流离失所如何影响跨国移民的发展实践
articles.abstract_en: This article contributes to research on migration and development, in particular to the studies that seek to move beyond ahistorical approaches and those that seek to explore the long-term consequences of internal displacement. Existing studies of migration and development have arrived at numerous insights into how transnational migrants act as agents of development in remittance-receiving regions. They have less often asked the related question; namely, how migrants’ ability to enact such roles is constrained or enabled by internal migration within these regions. This article demonstrates that processes of internal displacement and residential segregation within a remittance-receiving region influence where transnational migrants can direct their resources. It investigates how the development activities of transnational migrants (including household remittances, real estate investments, and philanthropic donations) are emplaced, and how emplacements and their meanings change over time. The analysis is based on multi-sited ethnographic research in a remittance-receiving region of India, a country that has been described as the largest recipient of remittances in the world, and with overseas Indians in the UK and the USA. While the overseas members of regionally powerful Hindu groups are relatively well-positioned to cultivate a role as agents of development in their villages of origin in Gujarat, the overseas Gujarati Muslims whose relatives left or lost power in their villages have been challenged to redirect their development activities to another location in the region. Drawing recent theorizations of home in relation with critical discussions of migration and development, the article views migrants’ development activities as homemaking; as emplaced efforts to cultivate relatedness and belonging.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文对移民与发展研究做出贡献，特别是那些试图超越非历史方法以及探索内部流离失所长期后果的研究。现有的移民与发展研究已就跨国移民如何在汇款接收地区充当发展推动者提出了诸多见解。但较少提出相关问题，即移民发挥此类作用的能力如何受到这些地区内部迁移的制约或促进。本文表明，汇款接收地区内部的流离失所和居住隔离过程会影响跨国移民资源投向何处。文章探讨了跨国移民的发展活动（包括家庭汇款、房地产投资和慈善捐赠）如何被安置，以及安置及其意义如何随时间变化。分析基于对印度一个汇款接收地区的多点民族志研究，印度被描述为世界上最大的汇款接收国，研究对象还包括在英美两国的海外印度人。虽然地区强势印度教群体的海外成员相对处于有利地位，能够在古吉拉特邦的原籍村庄培养发展推动者的角色，但海外古吉拉特穆斯林，其亲属离开或失去了在村庄中的权力，则面临挑战，不得不将发展活动转向该地区的另一地点。文章借鉴近期关于家的理论化，结合对移民与发展的批判性讨论，将移民的发展活动视为营造家园；即培养关联性和归属感的安置性努力。

articles.title_en: Drought-sensitive targeting and child growth faltering in Southern Africa
articles.title_cn: 干旱敏感型瞄准与南部非洲儿童生长迟缓
articles.abstract_en: We combine remote-sensed data and individual child, mother, and household level data for five countries in Sub-Saharan Africa (Malawi, Tanzania, Mozambique, Zambia, and Zimbabwe) to design a prototype drought-sensitive targeting framework that may be used in scarce-data contexts. To accomplish this we: i) develop simple and easy-to-communicate measures of drought shocks; ii) show that droughts have a large impact on child growth faltering in these five countries -- comparable, in size, to the effects of mother’s illiteracy, living in a house with a primitive roof, or to a fall to a lower wealth quintile; and iii) show that, in this context, decision trees and regressions predict growth faltering as accurately (out-of-sample) as machine learning methods that are not interpretable. Taken together, our analysis lends support to the idea that a data-driven targeting approach may contribute to the design of policies that alleviate the impact that climate change has on the world’s most vulnerable populations.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将遥感数据与撒哈拉以南非洲五国（马拉维、坦桑尼亚、莫桑比克、赞比亚和津巴布韦）的儿童、母亲和家庭层面的个体数据相结合，设计了一个可能在数据稀缺情境下使用的干旱敏感型瞄准框架原型。为实现这一目标，我们：i) 开发了简单且易于沟通的干旱冲击度量指标；ii) 表明在这五个国家，干旱对儿童生长迟缓有显著影响——其影响程度与母亲文盲、居住在简陋屋顶房屋或财富水平下降至较低五分位的影响相当；iii) 表明在此情境下，决策树和回归在样本外预测生长迟缓方面的准确性与不可解释的机器学习方法相当。综合来看，我们的分析支持这样一种观点：数据驱动的瞄准方法可能有助于设计缓解气候变化对世界上最脆弱人群影响的政策。

articles.title_en: Geography, development, and power: Parliament leaders and local clientelism
articles.title_cn: 地理、发展与权力：议会领导人与地方庇护主义
articles.abstract_en: While formal institutions are considered rather stable in Western countries, the same cannot be said of those in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). In LAC, these institutions are superseded by nonformalized but deeply embedded practices—especially of political favoritism. Accordingly, this paper explores how members of parliament in LAC favor their birth regions by providing clientelistic goods and services to their constituents. The paper shows that the development of subnational regions is affected by their proximity to parliament leaders’ birthplaces. We collect data on 366 political leaders’ birth locations over 1992–2016 and construct a panel of approximately 183,000 subnational micro–regions across 45 LAC countries/autonomous territories. Our results show that incumbent parliament leaders favor regions near their birthplaces, as measured by night light emissions and World Bank aid. This favoritism is enabled by the patterns of formal institutional weakness, and de jure plus de facto influence given to the parliament by the particularly unstable constitutions of LAC countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管正式制度在西方国家被认为相当稳定，但拉丁美洲和加勒比地区（LAC）的情况却并非如此。在LAC，这些制度被非正式但根深蒂固的实践所取代——尤其是政治偏袒。因此，本文探讨了LAC的议会成员如何通过向其选民提供庇护性商品和服务来偏袒其出生地区。本文表明，次国家地区的发展受到其与议会领导人生地距离的影响。我们收集了1992-2016年间366位政治领导人的出生地数据，并构建了一个涵盖45个LAC国家/自治领土约183,000个次国家微观地区的面板数据。我们的结果显示，现任议会领导人偏袒其出生地附近的地区，这通过夜间灯光排放和世界银行援助来衡量。这种偏袒是由正式制度薄弱模式以及LAC国家特别不稳定的宪法赋予议会的法律上和事实上的影响力所促成的。

articles.title_en: Patterns of government disaster policy response in Peru
articles.title_cn: 秘鲁政府灾害应对政策的模式
articles.abstract_en: Our study introduces a new quantitative dataset of government disaster responses for 183 disasters in Peru from 1900 to 2020. We examine disaster responses in the form of relocation of affected individuals, restrictions on movement, reconstruction of damaged areas, and regulations of third-party disaster relief. Prior analyses of large earthquakes and El Niño events in Peru reveal that government response to hazards shapes the outcomes for social, conflict, and economic outcomes. Our dataset contributes quantitative coding of a much larger sample of disasters to identify useful patterns in disaster response. We show that the Peruvian government is the most active actor in disaster response, although international organizations and non-governmental organizations are active in nearly a third of all disasters. Restrictions and relocation of affected populations occur, but this tends to be temporary, rather than long-term solutions to mitigate risks from future disasters. Relocation of affected people occurs more often for floods and landslides, while regulation of third-party activities occurs more frequently with floods and extreme temperature events; other disaster response policies do not vary across disaster types. Disaster responses have also shifted over time, with the government providing more funds for post-disaster reconstruction and coordinating with outside aid groups more actively in recent decades. The results demonstrate the feasibility and importance of tracking patterns of response across hazard events to fully understand the role of government in disaster response. Our larger data collection project will provide similar data for all countries over time, which will help us situate Peru’s patterns of disaster response in the larger disaster management landscape and understand how government policy choices influence political violence, migration, and other political dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们的研究引入了一个新的定量数据集，涵盖了1900年至2020年间秘鲁183起灾害的政府应对措施。我们考察了以受影响个体迁移、行动限制、受损区域重建以及第三方灾害救援监管为形式的灾害应对。先前对秘鲁大地震和厄尔尼诺事件的分析表明，政府对灾害的应对塑造了社会、冲突和经济结果。我们的数据集通过对更大样本的灾害进行定量编码，以识别灾害应对中的有用模式。我们表明，秘鲁政府是灾害应对中最活跃的行为体，尽管国际组织和非政府组织在近三分之一的灾害中也很活跃。对受影响人口的限制和迁移确实发生，但这往往是临时性的，而非减轻未来灾害风险的长期解决方案。受影响人口的迁移更常见于洪水和滑坡，而第三方活动的监管更频繁地出现在洪水和极端温度事件中；其他灾害应对政策在不同灾害类型间没有差异。灾害应对也随时间发生了变化，近几十年来，政府为灾后重建提供了更多资金，并更积极地与外部援助组织协调。结果表明，追踪灾害事件中的应对模式对于充分理解政府在灾害应对中的作用是可行且重要的。我们更大的数据收集项目将随时间提供所有国家的类似数据，这将有助于我们将秘鲁的灾害应对模式置于更广泛的灾害管理格局中，并理解政府政策选择如何影响政治暴力、移民和其他政治动态。

articles.title_en: Representation matters? Female legislators and women’s health in Bangladesh
articles.title_cn: 代表性重要吗？孟加拉国的女性立法者与女性健康
articles.abstract_en: Women’s political representation has increased substantially over recent decades due to concerted efforts, including quotas, to increase female legislative representation in electoral democracies. While studies find that female leadership improves educational outcomes and the provision of public health services, we know little about the impact of women leaders on their female constituents’ health status in less developed countries. In this study, we take advantage of novel geocoded survey data in Bangladesh to employ spatial–temporal methods for investigating whether the presence of women parliamentarians improves prenatal care usage − a key maternal health indicator. Using three different identification approaches, we find evidence, contrary to our expectations, that women’s electoral representation decreases the likelihood of prenatal clinic attendance in electoral districts in Bangladesh. Reflecting on the unusual findings, we explore several factors that may contribute to the maternal health status in woman-led constituencies. Our analysis suggests that women’s electoral representation does not spontaneously improve outcomes for women’s issues. The counterintuitive findings imply that political-institutional and electoral contexts, as well as political culture, may mitigate the impact of women’s political agency on gender-sensitive development outcomes in less developed countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，由于包括配额在内的协同努力，女性在选举民主制中的立法代表比例大幅增加。虽然研究发现女性领导能改善教育成果和公共卫生服务的提供，但我们对欠发达国家中女性领导对其女性选民健康状况的影响知之甚少。在本研究中，我们利用孟加拉国新颖的地理编码调查数据，采用时空方法调查女性议员的存在是否改善了产前保健使用——一个关键的孕产妇健康指标。使用三种不同的识别方法，我们发现与我们的预期相反，女性选举代表降低了孟加拉国选区产前诊所就诊的可能性。反思这些不寻常的发现，我们探讨了可能导致女性领导选区孕产妇健康状况的几个因素。我们的分析表明，女性选举代表并不会自发改善女性议题的结果。这些反直觉的发现意味着，政治制度和选举背景以及政治文化可能会削弱女性政治机构对欠发达国家性别敏感发展成果的影响。

articles.title_en: The short-term effects of visa restrictions on migrants’ legal status and well-being: A difference-in-differences approach on Venezuelan displacement
articles.title_cn: 签证限制对移民法律身份和福祉的短期影响：针对委内瑞拉流离失所者的双重差分方法
articles.abstract_en: Most countries across the globe introduce visa restrictions to regulate immigration, yet little is known about their effect on migrants’ decision to migrate and their well-being. I study the mass displacement of Venezuelan nationals, and through a difference-in-differences research design, I compare the effectiveness of introducing visa restrictions in reducing overall migration flows in certain countries across South America. I use a data set of 85,000 migrants and refugees − mostly Venezuelans − surveyed by the UNHCR. Findings suggest that visa restrictions increased the likelihood of irregular entry and irregular visa status for migrants while also leading to changes in their priorities. Unexpectedly, I do not find evidence of increased violence suffered by migrants who switch towards irregular entry channels in specific countries. This research contributes to the academic and policy debate on the effectiveness of visa restrictions on migratory flows, as well the literature on the effects of migration policies on migrants’ well-being.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球大多数国家引入签证限制以规范移民，但对其对移民迁移决策和福祉的影响知之甚少。我研究了委内瑞拉国民的大规模流离失所，并通过双重差分研究设计，比较了在南美洲某些国家引入签证限制在减少总体移民流动方面的有效性。我使用了联合国难民署调查的包含85,000名移民和难民（主要是委内瑞拉人）的数据集。研究结果表明，签证限制增加了移民非正常入境和非正常签证身份的可能性，同时也导致了他们优先事项的变化。出乎意料的是，我没有发现证据表明在特定国家转向非正常入境渠道的移民遭受的暴力有所增加。这项研究为关于签证限制对移民流动有效性的学术和政策辩论，以及关于移民政策对移民福祉影响的文献做出了贡献。

articles.title_en: Do earthquakes increase or decrease crime?
articles.title_cn: 地震会增加还是减少犯罪？
articles.abstract_en: Theories on the relationship between earthquakes and crime present mixed predictions. On the one hand, earthquakes improve individual cooperation, social trust, and crime reduction. On the other hand, earthquakes impact state capacity and enhance the prevalence of motivated offenders such as street gangs. This study empirically analyzes the effects of the September 2017 earthquakes in Mexico on personal crimes (assault and aggravated assault) and property crimes (vehicle theft, residential burglary, and vandalism). Using official police data, a difference-in-differences technique, and an event-study design, the results show that earthquakes increased assault by 14 percent and vandalism by 8 percent.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于地震与犯罪之间关系的理论提出了混合的预测。一方面，地震改善了个人合作、社会信任，并减少了犯罪。另一方面，地震影响了国家能力，并增加了诸如街头帮派等有动机的犯罪者的普遍性。本研究实证分析了2017年九月墨西哥地震对人身犯罪（袭击和严重袭击）和财产犯罪（车辆盗窃、住宅入室盗窃和故意破坏）的影响。使用官方警方数据、双重差分技术和事件研究设计，结果表明地震使袭击增加了14%，故意破坏增加了8%。

articles.title_en: Chronicle of a disaster foretold: The politics of restoring Lake Urmia (Iran)
articles.title_cn: 一场预言的灾难纪事：恢复乌尔米耶湖（伊朗）的政治
articles.abstract_en: Like many of the world’s large-scale terminal lakes, the Urmia saltwater lake in northwestern Iran is undergoing a process of desiccation. The anticipated economic, social, environmental and health consequences of this are daunting. We set out to examine the policies that have been designed in response to the lake crisis in the past twenty years. We focus on the set of measures proposed by the Urmia Lake Restoration Program (ULRP) and explain why their impact on water savings are overstated while the potentially most effective measures are abandoned. We then discuss the various social, institutional and political factors that have led to this state of affairs. Identifying and understanding the array of political and other factors that combine not only to impede appropriate remedial measures but also to fuel the overexploitation of water are essential to our comprehension of how to avert unsustainable water futures.
articles.abstract_cn: 与世界许多大型终端湖泊一样，伊朗西北部的乌尔米耶盐湖正在经历干涸过程。由此预期的经济、社会、环境和健康后果令人望而生畏。我们着手考察过去二十年中为应对湖泊危机而设计的政策。我们重点关注乌尔米耶湖恢复计划（ULRP）提出的一系列措施，并解释为何其对节水的效果被夸大，而可能最有效的措施却被放弃。随后，我们讨论了导致这一状况的各种社会、制度和政治因素。识别并理解那些不仅阻碍适当补救措施，而且助长水资源过度开发的各种政治及其他因素的组合，对于我们理解如何避免不可持续的水资源未来至关重要。

articles.title_en: Navigating food price shocks in a pandemic: Food insecurity and coping mechanisms in Burkina Faso
articles.title_cn: 疫情期间应对食品价格冲击：布基纳法索的粮食不安全与应对机制
articles.abstract_en: Global food prices rose substantially after the start of the COVID-19 pandemic. This paper examines the impact of rising food prices during the pandemic on food security in Burkina Faso. We aim to answer two primary questions. First, how do food price shocks affect household food insecurity? Second, what coping strategies do households adopt in response to these price shocks? Leveraging country-wide high-frequency longitudinal data, we employ household fixed effect models to examine the effects. In the absence of direct information on local food prices, we use household-reported price shocks to capture province-level price increases and show that the results are consistent with national-level price increases.
articles.abstract_cn: COVID-19疫情开始后，全球食品价格大幅上涨。本文考察了疫情期间食品价格上涨对布基纳法索粮食安全的影响。我们旨在回答两个主要问题。第一，食品价格冲击如何影响家庭粮食不安全？第二，家庭在面对这些价格冲击时采取了哪些应对策略？利用全国范围的高频纵向数据，我们采用家庭固定效应模型来检验这些影响。在缺乏当地食品价格直接信息的情况下，我们使用家庭报告的物价冲击来捕捉省级价格上涨，并表明结果与全国层面的价格上涨一致。

articles.title_en: Marginals within the marginalised: Exploring the changes in occupational pattern among Adivasi women in the context of land alienation in India
articles.title_cn: 边缘化中的边缘化：探索印度土地异化背景下原住民妇女职业模式的变化
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the changes in occupational patterns and addresses the problem of transitioning from paid activities to unpaid activities among Adivasi women in the context of land alienation. We use data sources, viz. the 50th and 68th rounds of Employment and Unemployment Survey, the Periodic Labour Force Survey (2022–23) and the Time Use Survey (2019) of the NSSO. We apply simple descriptive statistics, binary and multinomial logistic regression models to derive reasonable inferences. The study reveals that between 1993–94 and 2011–12, Adivasi women’s labour force participation has declined more when compared to women from other social groups. However, between 2011–12 and 2023–24, their participation has increased which can be attributed to increase in their participation in unpaid family labour and own account works. The study deduces that landholding size determines their participation in the labour market, and quality of occupations. Larger landholding size is an enabling factor which enhances the propensity of Adivasi women to take up better-paid occupations, while lower landholding size increases the risk of taking up either employment in precarious occupations or unpaid domestic duties. The findings reinforce the argument that landholdings play a crucial role among Adivasis in maintaining the relative egalitarian values in their society. Finally, this study suggests measures to improve the LFPR of Adivasi women and the quality of their employment.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了土地异化背景下原住民妇女的职业模式变化，并解决了从有酬活动向无酬活动转变的问题。我们使用数据源，即。 NSSO 的第 50 和 68 轮就业和失业调查、定期劳动力调查 (2022-23) 和时间使用调查 (2019)。我们应用简单的描述性统计、二元和多项逻辑回归模型来得出合理的推论。研究显示，在1993-94和2011-12之间，与其他社会群体的女性相比，原住民女性的劳动力参与率下降更多。然而，在2011-12和2023-24之间，他们的参与有所增加，这可以归因于他们对无酬家庭劳动和自营工作的参与增加。研究推断，土地拥有规模决定了他们对劳动力市场的参与以及职业质量。较大的土地拥有规模是一个有利因素，它提高了原住民妇女从事收入较高职业的倾向，而较小的土地拥有规模则增加了从事不稳定职业或无偿家务劳动的风险。研究结果强化了这样的论点，即土地所有权在原住民中在维持社会相对平等价值观方面发挥着至关重要的作用。最后，本研究提出了提高原住民妇女的劳动参与率及其就业质量的措施。

articles.title_en: The role of the commodity price boom in shaping public social spending: Evidence from Latin America
articles.title_cn: 大宗商品价格繁荣在塑造公共社会支出中的作用：来自拉丁美洲的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the potential impact of the commodity price boom of 2003 to 2013 on public social spending in Latin America. We estimate structural vector autoregressions and local projections for 16 Latin American countries over the period from 1990 to 2019 and investigate if we can attribute increases in public spending on health, education, and social protection to increases in a country’s net commodity terms-of-trade. By focusing on the impulse responses derived from country-specific estimations, we find a huge variety in response patterns. Our study finds that two countries experienced lasting increases in public social spending due to the commodity boom (Argentina, Ecuador). Some others observed at least temporary increases of few years (Brazil, Mexico), reacted first with declines and then rises (Chile), and yet others did not respond at all (Bolivia, Colombia, Peru). As expected, we cannot relate public social spending with commodity prices in countries without commodity price boom. Among countries with positive responses, there is no clear tendency concerning the function of spending that benefits most. We discuss potential explanations behind the heterogeneity of our country-wise results and conclude that the presence of left-wing governments, fiscal rules, natural resource funds and economic diversification provide plausible explanations for single country cases, but no general patterns emerge. We conclude that the commodity price boom was neither necessary nor sufficient for social policy expansion in Latin America, and factors explaining its effects differ from country to country. Our study highlights the importance of in-depth examinations of country-specific factors and the need of (currently lacking) high-quality time series data in development research.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了2003年至2013年大宗商品价格繁荣对拉丁美洲公共社会支出的潜在影响。我们估计了1990年至2019年期间16个拉丁美洲国家的结构向量自回归和局部投影，并调查我们是否可以将卫生、教育和社会保护公共支出的增加归因于国家净商品贸易条件的改善。通过关注从国家特定估计中得出的脉冲响应，我们发现了响应模式的巨大差异。我们的研究发现，两个国家（阿根廷、厄瓜多尔）因大宗商品繁荣而经历了公共社会支出的持续增加。其他国家中，有的至少观察到几年的暂时性增加（巴西、墨西哥），有的先下降后上升（智利），还有的根本没有响应（玻利维亚、哥伦比亚、秘鲁）。正如预期，在没有大宗商品价格繁荣的国家，我们无法将公共社会支出与大宗商品价格联系起来。在具有正向响应的国家中，关于受益最多的支出功能没有明确趋势。我们讨论了国家层面结果异质性背后的潜在解释，并得出结论，左翼政府的存在、财政规则、自然资源基金和经济多元化提供了对单个国家案例的合理解释，但没有出现普遍模式。我们得出结论，大宗商品价格繁荣既不是拉丁美洲社会政策扩张的必要条件也不是充分条件，解释其影响的因素因国家而异。我们的研究强调了深入考察国家特定因素的重要性，以及发展研究中（目前缺乏的）高质量时间序列数据的必要性。

articles.title_en: Patterns of temporary rural migration: A study in northern Bangladesh
articles.title_cn: 临时性农村迁移的模式：孟加拉国北部的一项研究
articles.abstract_en: Migration from rural to urban areas is common in many low- and middle-income countries. However, temporary migration from rural to other rural areas also occurs and is not yet well understood. Here, we conceptualize what drives rural people to migrate temporarily to other rural areas, rather than to urban areas where wages are usually higher. This question is analysed with qualitative data collected through group discussions and in-depth interviews with randomly selected households in northern rural Bangladesh, where temporary migration is widely observed. The data reveal that temporary migration is common especially among poor agriculture-dependent households with farm labour and family demographic constraints that prevent longer-term migration. Many temporary migrants prefer rural over urban destinations, influenced by their limited skills, social networks, negative perceptions of cities, and the comparative income-cost ratios between destinations. Our findings suggest that the notion of temporary migration in low- and middle-income countries being primarily a rural-to-urban move needs to be re-evaluated.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多低收入和中等收入国家，从农村向城市地区的迁移很常见。然而，从农村向其他农村地区的临时性迁移也会发生，但尚未得到充分理解。在此，我们概念化了是什么驱使农村人口临时迁移到其他农村地区，而不是迁移到通常工资更高的城市地区。这一问题通过小组讨论和对孟加拉国北部农村随机选择的家庭进行的深度访谈所收集的定性数据进行分析，该地区临时性迁移现象普遍。数据显示，临时性迁移在依赖农业的贫困家庭中尤为常见，这些家庭面临农业劳动力和家庭人口结构的限制，阻碍了长期迁移。许多临时迁移者更倾向于农村而非城市目的地，这受到他们有限的技能、社会网络、对城市的负面看法以及目的地之间相对收入-成本比率的影响。我们的研究结果表明，需要重新评估低收入和中等收入国家临时性迁移主要是农村向城市流动的观点。
